 November keeps October’s promises
 By Whitney Will • Published Oct 30, 2026 SplashNews/Shutterstock/PureWow November is the month where urge becomes action. It is the story of how the internal changes of October shape our future plans. We decide who we are and what parts of our lives need our attention and effort. November is where Venus and Mercury pass the baton to Mars.
 The month begins in the shadow of two retrogrades: Venus and Mercury. Venus retrograde changes the source of meaning in our lives, while Mercury retrograde changes the tone of the narration. Both of these shifts occur in Scorpio, and so likely have to do with confronting some kind of shadow. Whether that is something we try to avoid, a part of ourselves or our relationships we have trouble owning or a yuckier part of reality we try to pretend doesn’t exist, we’ve likely had to spend some part of the last month with biohazard suits on, digging through topics we would usually prefer not to.
 The first week of November gives some insight as to where to go from here. On November 4th, Venus harmonizes with Jupiter as Mercury lines up with the sun. The first of these alignments offers optimism and helps articulate a vision for a hopeful ‘best-case scenario.’ The second provides an ‘aha’ moment where the path to that moment becomes clearer, and sketches for a plan can be made.
 On November 5th, Mars enters the pre-shadow of its upcoming retrograde that will define the beginning of 2027. The warrior (Mars) is taking cues from the head (Mercury) and the heart (Venus) as to what changes must be wrought in our lives, and begins foreshadowing the battles we will fight or negotiate through in the early parts of 2027. Pay attention. Little stuff now likely signals larger themes that are not going away.
 The Scorpio new moon on the 8th gives a view of the next lunar month ahead and resets the Scorpio parts of our lives. Under the auspices of this moon, Mars and Venus join hands on the 9th, the lovers finally on the same team, sowing seeds of purpose together, so starkly different from their quarrel during October’s Libra new moon. It bodes well for collaboration during difficult circumstances.
 On Friday the 13th, both Venus and Mercury station direct and end their retrogrades. Their synchronicity is significant, as it winds down related storylines and divides the month in two. Venus moves forward from her home sign of Libra, while Mercury integrates the secret workings of Scorpio. Their purposes renewed, communication, values and relationships should begin to move forward with increasing efficiency.
 The drama shifts to the pileup of Mars, Jupiter and the South Node. Mars is the personal will, Jupiter expands and supports whatever is in contact with it and the South Node siphons old material away. Mars in Leo is easy to interpret—the brazen hero—while Jupiter and the South Node are tricky to guess at because they represent fundamentally opposite processes. Jupiter creates more, while the South Node reduces whatever it touches. It’s like the dentist pouring water in and sucking it out of your mouth at the same time. Whatever Mars is doing, it is likely to change things fast. Expect these shifts from the 11th–16th.
 The sun wrestles with the Mars-Jupiter-South Node story from the 17th–19th, a week where we integrate that experience into our overall purpose and life focus.
 On the 21st, the sun shifts gears into Sagittarius, and Uranus interrupts the party. There’s an exciting full moon on the 24th that highlights Uranus in Gemini, zooming in on the themes of liberation and rebellion it’s brought to that sector over the last seven months. It’s anything but stable. The following day, Mars enters Virgo. Mars in Virgo is less performative than Mars in Leo, but what he lacks in dramatic flair is made up for in an absolute focus on perfection and productivity. Mars in Virgo is the project manager and skilled artisan, relentless in pursuit of his craft or deadline.
 The month ends sweetly with another harmonious Venus-Jupiter aspect, a steadying touchstone between the sun and Saturn, and Mercury leaving the echoes of its retrograde. Enjoy the Thanksgiving calm, as December gets rowdy again quickly.
 (Horoscopes follow for each sign. If you know your rising sign, reading for that sign may provide further insight.) 
 purewow Aries (March 21 - April 19)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): deeper themes
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): say everything all at once
 Mars conjoins Jupiter (November 15): hype-maxxing
 This month, you are what you create, and the needle you must thread is about the limits of your personal control. You must stay present and take action while not letting go of the awareness that much of what happens is beyond your control. Lean into the story, but don’t delude yourself that you can be both author and participant. The themes at play this month will take the next seven months to play out.
 Love Horoscope: There’s no better moment for your relationships than the second week of the month. A new moon in your house of intimacy, a sweet connection between Mars and Venus on the 9th and a lucky alignment between Mars and Jupiter in your pleasure sector on the 15th all bode well. Go get it.
 Money Horoscope: Money matters improve from last month. Your money planet is in better condition and stations direct midmonth, so as long as your relationships are good, money will be too. But again, refrain from taking huge risks due to unpredictable outcomes, especially from the 11th–15th.

 purewow Taurus (April 20 - May 20)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): relationship reset
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): financial surprises
 Venus goes direct (November 13): back to your normally scheduled programming
 Relationships are still very much the focus for this month, but you’re making good progress. Critical insights are becoming obvious, and you can talk things through in productive ways. When Venus and Mercury go direct on the 13th, it all starts paying off. Cue the fireworks at home. The Leo pileup shifts the dynamic of your home life, and a spicy Gemini full moon has you zoomed in on finances. Mars moving into your fun house on the 25th gets creative and focused.
 Love Horoscope: There’s a deeper story lining up that will shape your next six months, and when Mars enters the pre-shadow of its upcoming retrograde on the 5th, it starts dropping hints. Relationships at home are likely to transform quickly, especially the 11th–15th. Maybe you’re moving or shifting things around to accommodate your current relationship, or maybe it’s a major upgrade.
 Money Horoscope: The full moon in Gemini highlights the dynamism and desire for independence in your financial life. While it might feel thrilling to make a break for self-sufficiency, there are likely to be some challenges. When the sun enters Sagittarius on the 21st, you may need to rely more on financial support from your partner.

 purewow Gemini (May 21 - June 20)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): brush your teeth
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): all the pressure to make a decision
 Mars in Virgo (November 25–February 21): rebuild the foundation
 Your health continues to be a topic this month, but in a positive way. You’re more grounded in your body and your physical routine, and you can make empowered choices about your weekly schedule to support your health and stress levels. When the Sun moves into Sagittarius, your focus shifts to relationships, and communication becomes a lot easier.
 Love Horoscope: Relationships start out in a positive place and only improve throughout the month. Feel free to make the first move or deepen the connection—both planets of luck and love are on your side the whole time.
 Money Horoscope: Money is not a big focus of the month, likely because it might be running a bit thin. Play it safe and stay conservative on the Black Friday sales. By the end of the month, on the 29th, you’ll have a much better idea of your budget for the holidays.

 purewow Cancer (June 21 - July 22)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): what are you bringing into the world?
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): say everything all at once
 Venus in Libra (October 25–December 4): harmony in your home sector
 Home continues to be a space of focus this month, as the ruler of your home sector is holed up there for the entirety of November. A new moon in your creativity space has you bringing something new into the world and reorganizing your routine around it. Your financial sector is going through a serious upgrade as a possible promotion comes up. Make sure you ask for the pay bump as well.
 Love Horoscope: There are many dynamic areas of life for you, Cancer, but relationships are not seeing big shifts. Dating continues to have some spice to it, but there aren’t significant changes to your relationship status. It’s time to be self-reliant and enjoy the sweeter aspects of home without pursuing a whole new partner.
 Money Horoscope: Money continues to be a very exciting story as Mars finally meets up with Jupiter on the 15th. You have the will and the luck to negotiate higher compensation but be sure you know why you’re asking. Your purpose is half the battle, and if your heart is not fully in it, it’s likely to fall flat.
 RELATED Cancer Compatibility: Your Most Suited Zodiac Signs, Ranked from Worst to Best 
 purewow Leo (July 23 - Aug 22)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): what does home mean to you?
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): hopes and dreams for the future
 Sun and Jupiter in mutual reception (11/21–12/21): in the creative flow
 You’re still on fire from last month, but this month it keeps you warm. You’re getting a real plan in place for how to deal with your parents or living situation, but the plan is just the plan. Execution of said plan is likely to be a longer process that will characterize the first half of 2027. But don’t let that worry you just yet. Mid-November is absolutely powerful, with tons of energy expanding your sense of self. When your ruler, the sun, enters Sagittarius on the 21st, your luck only increases.
 Love Horoscope: Relationships might seem more important, but they’re still in a holding pattern this month for the most part. When we enter Sagittarius season, though, you might be feeling a little flirtier and start to get noticed.
 Money Horoscope: Money gets less complicated after the 13th, but you’re still balancing the books until the 29th. Lean on your networking skills to find resources and invest in building connections with other people in your field and neighborhood. When Mars enters your money house on the 25th, you can make some productive investments.

 purewow Virgo (August 23 - September 23)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): new calendar, who dis?
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): the work you were born for
 Mars in your sign (November 25–February 21): beast mode
 Right away, there’s more clarity in November than last month, when your ruling planet Mercury comes together with the Sun on the 4th. The insights from then should point you in the right direction for the remainder of the retrograde. After Mercury stations direct on the 13th, the immediate details are organized, but there are larger things at work outside of your control. Things are likely to get messy fast, but when the sun enters Sagittarius, they’ll be more in your favor.
 Love Horoscope: I wouldn’t worry about romance this month, because it’s not in your control. If you are surprised by a handsome stranger, great, but you couldn’t find them if you tried. Let go of needing a certain outcome and accept what comes.
 Money Horoscope: Money is probably the best area of your life this month, as the money planet hangs out there the whole time, and she’s vibing. A fortunate alignment on the 4th gets repeated on the 28th, so consider buying a lottery ticket just for fun.

 purewow Libra (September 23 - October 21)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): be the change
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): leave the country
 Venus in Libra (October 25–December 4): everybody loves you
 November is divided in two. In the first half, until the 13th, your ruling planet Venus is retrograde in your sign. She’s consolidating your identity and self-concept, redrawing the lines of meaning and purpose in the roles you assign yourself. The full moon later in the month pulls your gaze from the mirror and up to your goals. How have your plans for the future shifted in the last six months?
 Love Horoscope: Relationships grow in complexity as the ruler of your relationship sector begins to reflect on its role and empowerment. While the true action won't happen until the new year, the groundwork is being laid, and the scene is being set. Keep your eyes open and take notes.
 Money Horoscope: November develops the remaining themes of October, and your personal finances are a big one. How you acquire money and what you use it for reflect on your identity in big ways this month. Your values might shift and your perspective might change as you reflect on the role you want to play in the story.

 purewow Scorpio (October 22 - November 21)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): what cycle are you beginning?
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): debauchery
 Mars with Jupiter (November 15): peacocking
 November is powerful for you, Scorpio, not just because it’s your season, but because this year your season lands at full volume. The stakes are incredibly high, and you know it. While the ground shifts underneath and inside you, the best thing to do is sit with it and try to be present for whatever is emerging. This is likely difficult, especially around the 15th, when your ruling planet teams up with Jupiter in the most visible sector of your chart. The need to be seen might be too much to not hard launch who you’ve become.
 Love Horoscope: It’s hard to decipher what you really want this month as the relationship planet spends all her time in the most hidden part of your chart. You’ll have to feel your way through it in the dark. Romance is fun, but you’re not sure about commitment just yet.
 Money Horoscope: It’s a month for financial power moves. A big shift on the 11th is likely to clear away old ideas about your relationship with money, but you’re not ready to take action until several days later, on the 15th. When the sun enters your money house on the 21st, luck is on your side.

 purewow Sagittarius (November 22 - December 21)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): hello from the other side
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): my, how your relationship has changed
 Mars conjoins Jupiter (November 15): go all in
 Your ruling planet calls you out on a big adventure this month as Jupiter and Mars meet up in your space of long-distance travel, higher education, and long-term planning. What you are envisioning is shifting in its form but growing in its ambition. This month will go well if you push yourself into new territory and resist the urge to isolate or collapse. When the Sun enters your sign on the 21st, it’ll all make a lot more sense.
 Love Horoscope: The first half of the month is not the time for love, as your relationship planet is struggling to engage or find the right words. After the 13th, things begin to move forward, but it’s the full moon on the 24th that really has you coming out of your shell and making some surprising connections.
 Money Horoscope: It’s crickets in financial news this month, but that’s not necessarily a bad thing. It rings of stability as your planet consolidates until stationing direct next month. Your investments feel especially steady by the end of the month when the sun aligns with Saturn on the 29th.

 purewow Capricorn (December 22 - January 19)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): make a vision board
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): wash your hands
 Venus in Libra (October 25–December 4): career opportunities
 The month starts with you trying to get everything under control and ends with you surrendering to whatever the gods have in store for you. There’s been a lot of having to let go of your own timeline, so I feel for you, Capricorn. The best news is that career matters that stalled out in August get moving again in positive directions. You don’t have to know where it’s all going to say yes to the next good thing.
 Love Horoscope: Your best days for love are the 16th and 17th, that is, if you can get yourself out there and be bold enough to approach a stranger. The 22nd is also not a bad day for flirting or a fun date with your sweetie. Keep Thanksgiving a little more intimate this year.
 Money Horoscope: Money is likely to be a dynamic topic this month. Your personal finances hold steady while your partner’s might fluctuate wildly, especially midmonth. By the 29th, you're both on the same page and can collaborate about your budget for the holidays.

 purewow Aquarius (January 20 - February 18)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): new career era
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): remember fun?
 Mars conjoins Jupiter (November 15): make the first move
 November keeps October’s promises, and the changes that sounded like good ideas are likely already in motion. The retrogrades in your career sector redraw your plans, and Venus in your 9th house brings you back to your core beliefs. The rubber meets the road midmonth when you integrate all these changes into your relational life and upgrade the way you show up as a partner. A full moon at the end of the month draws your eye back to the space of fun and creativity, so lean into the holidays with joy as the top priority.
 Love Horoscope: Your love life is all lit up this month! Mars, Jupiter and the South Node work hard to upgrade the status quo of your relationships and to challenge any complacency. Mercury rewrites contracts of financial and emotional labor and a full moon in your house of pleasure reminds you to speak your fantasies aloud.
 Money Horoscope: You may be making some kind of shift that causes you to rely on financial support from your partner as you realign your career goals and plans. Your money planet meeting up with the South Node on the 11th means that your finances might be going toward more spiritual aims, but you’ll still need a way to pay the bills.

 purewow Pisces (February 19 - March 20)
 New moon in Scorpio (11/8): litigation negotiations
 Full moon in Gemini (11/24): move out
 Jupiter on the South Node (November 15): upgrading your habits
 November tries to resolve things. Venus is at the negotiating table while Mercury draws up plans for possible resolutions. Whatever shakes out, you should have more answers midmonth when they both station direct on the 13th. Your ruling planet Jupiter is looking for renewal and healing around this time also, but it’s probably something you’ll need to fight for instead of just hoping it’ll happen. A full moon in your home sector looks like big changes.
 Love Horoscope: Relationships are trying to steady themselves, but there’s so much work to do before you can trust them again. You’ve been so topsy-turvy that it’s not clear what you even want anymore. Spend November figuring it out; December will bring much more clarity.
 Money Horoscope: November 9th is the best day for finances, so if you need to broker deals, lean on that one. You might be feeling optimistic on the 15th, but best to play it safe and not go all in. When your money planet enters your relationship house on the 25th, you get more support from others.
